source_contract.inheritance: MRAData derives WidgetBaseData, not StatusLabelTypeData/AppGroup. Its low-three-bit status setter does not reset index fields.
source_contract.status: Exact byte1 setter uses value+(old&0xF8), then StatusDisplayValueEditable notification intent; offered values0/3/1/2/5 preserve upper five bits. The setter does not itself mask/clamp arbitrary caller values. FunctionVariant has unequal-byte6 guard.
source_contract.zone_macro_getter: Exact list Find; absent pair writes first source pair via setter. Explicit getter effects, not automatic view evaluation.
source_contract.label_type: Both Zone LabelDisplayType accessors throw NotImplementedException; no type picker is admitted.
source_contract.icon_order: SourceSelect writes on then off; SourceControl off then on. Zone inherits independent on/off.
source_contract.defaults: SourceSelect status Source allocation occurs before icon setters and requested edits; all original default calls/bodies remain pinned.
source_contract.hidden_references: SourceSelect always reserves its status and label indices; Zone status reserved only for static type5; SourceControl reserves only label.
source_contract.global_order: Initialize captures first loaded MRA globals. BeforeSave saves static/scenes, propagates Zone then Multiplexer and later calls inherited forced values.
source_contract.binding_mode: 25 exact panel bindings; default mode versus explicit1/2 retained separately. Declaration constants are not a host parsing/scheduling proof.
source_contract.static_callbacks: Explicit Enter-key/Leave/selection callbacks WriteValue then ReadValue; eligible list refresh only ReadValue; no implicit close or schedule.
